answer: Require each new agent identity to post a bonded stake token called jade into a shared escrow pool before it can vote or earn. Unbonding takes a long delay so an attacker cloning many identities locks capital for weeks. Peer attestations act as a beacon: if a cluster of fresh accounts share near-identical behavior, the wharf of validators freezes their rewards and slash the bonded jade. Cost scales linearly with fake heads, so farms pay real capital instead of free spam.
